card.name: Pairwise coprime integers below 512 with large sum of 1/(512 - a)

task.name: Pairwise coprime integers below 512 with large sum of 1/(512 - a)
task.description: construct() -> distinct pairwise coprime integers a in 1..511. The score is sum 1/(512 - a) (exact rational, reported as a float); the report also gives sum over primes p < 512 of 1/p. Maximize. Large sums for n = 512 compared with the prime reciprocal sum are finite evidence on the conjectured bound.
